title: DS spec document manifest
description: Per-document metadata (the ID-less preamble: Status / What this is / Paired with). Per STYL.5.4. `preamble` is the verbatim leading text for lossless render.

src.description: Repo-relative path of the source Markdown (for the round-trip gate check, STYL.5.5).

proto.description: Proto files the atoms/enums are defined in.

preamble.description: Verbatim leading Markdown before the first clause (H1 + Status/What-this-is/Paired-with). Reproduced first on render; lossless round-trip (STYL.5.6).
